title: Savoury Chilli Chocolate Rice
description: A Mexican mole-inspired baked rice dish with chicken, peppers and tomatoes in a cocoa, peanut butter and chilli sauce.
ingredients: 2 red peppers, deseeded and finely chopped

MOLE PASTE: 1 tbsp cocoa powder, 1 tbsp smooth peanut butter, 1 tbsp tomato purée, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, juice of 1 lime
TO SERVE: coriander leaves, spring onions finely chopped, red chilli finely chopped, lime wedges
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C (400°F), Gas Mark 6.
Make the mole paste by mixing all ingredients in a small bowl.
Spray a large flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and fry the onion for 3 minutes, then add the garlic, tomatoes and peppers. Stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and the mole paste, increase the heat and stir-fry for about 1 minute.

Stir in the rice, then the hot stock, stir again and place the lid on the pot. Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for 20 minutes. Check the rice, remove and leave to rest for 5 minutes. Stir and garnish before serving.
notes: For a chicken mole-style sauce without rice, follow steps 2-4, then add a 400g can of chopped tomatoes and 150ml water and simmer for 25 minutes. Serve over rice or cauliflower rice.
